name: Viewer
definition: The user has permission to view data

name: Editor
definition: The user Has permission to insert, update, delete rows in tables. They can NOT modify the schema

name: Manager
definition: The user has permission to assign roles to users in a schema. They can modify the schema including creating, editing, and removing tables and columns

name: Owner
definition: The user has full permission to modify the schema and data stored within it

name: Aggregator
definition: The user has permission to count table rows (unless <10) and view ontology data

name: Count
definition: The user Has permission to count table rows and view ontology data

name: Range
definition: The user has permission to count table rows, with a step-size of 10 (e.g. 10,20..120,130 etc.) and view ontology data

name: Exists
definition: The user has permission to see if data exists given certain filters and view ontology data
